The combined application of 100 kg N and 6 ton ha-1 vermcompost ha−1 increased total root yield, dry root yield, harvest index, fresh root weight and root length.
the integrated application of 50kg N ha-1and 6 ton vermi compost ha-1 increased the total root yield (T), harvest index (HI) and fresh root weight of nantes carrot.
combined application of 100 kg N/ha and 6 ton/ha vermicompost was significantly superior for yield and yield components than the other treatments.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of nitrogen and vermi compost on the production of carrot.
the study of integrated effect of nitrogen (N) and vermicopost levels on yield and its components of carrot.
the effect of integrated application of nitrogen and vermin compost on growth, yield, and yield components of carrots.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the combined application of vermicompost and nitrogen at 6 ton and 50 kg N/ha, respectively, significantly (P < 0.05), increased total root yield, dry root weight, harvest index and fresh weight of root.
the integrated effect of N and vermicomposts significantly increased the yield of carrot and the highest yield (60 t ha−1) was recorded from the combination of 50 kgN ha−1 and 6ton vermcompost ha−1.
, maximum carrot yield can be obtained from a combination of 50 kg of N fertilizer and 6 t ha-1 vermicompost.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the application of nitrogen fertilizer alone or vermicompost alone could not give the best yield.
, the combined application of N and vermicomposts significantly (p < 0.05 or p < 0.01) increased total root, fresh root and harvest index of carrot.
the combined application of nitrogen and vermi compost at the rate of 50 kg ha-1 and vermicompos at the rate of6 tons ha-1 was the optimum combination to get the maximum root yield of carrot.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can increase the production of carrots through the use of organic fertilizer, such as vermicompost.
the integrated application of 50kg N ha-1and 6 ton vermicompost ha-1 is recommended for carrot production in the study area.
the combined application of vermicompost and N fertilizer at the rates of 6 tons and 50 kg ha-1, respectively, is the best treatment for carrot production.
